title: How to play Bus
intro: **Welcome aboard.** The City Transit Authority has given your company a licence to run a bus line. Learn the game by playing your first rounds against Mila and Bram.

steps.welcome: This city is growing fast, and its people are always on the move, between home, the office and the pub. You run a bus company, and your buses take them where they want to go. You score a point for every passenger you deliver, and the company with the most points at the end wins.
steps.goal: Your points are shown here, beside your name. Everyone starts at zero.
steps.map: This is the city. Its streets meet at crossings. Your company will lay a bus line along the streets, from crossing to crossing, and your buses will only ever drive on that line.
steps.locations: The numbered circles are building locations. Each one belongs to the crossing its thin line runs to. For now only the zone 1 locations can be built on. Zone 2 opens once every zone 1 location is built, then zone 3, then zone 4.
steps.clock: The clock shows the time of day. It points at the house: right now everyone wants to be at home. Each round it moves on, from house to office to pub and round again, so the passengers keep wanting to go somewhere new.
steps.passengers: Four passengers start on the roundabouts beside Central Park. 11 passengers are waiting to be added to the board. New passengers arrive by train, at the two stations.
steps.tray: These pieces are yours. Twenty action markers: you spend one each time you take an action, and spent markers are gone for good. One of your buses is already in the depot on the board. The other four, beside your markers, are buses you can buy later. And you hold the start-bus, so you go first.
steps.fb-intro: Before the first round, the city needs some buildings. Each of us puts up two, on zone 1 locations, and you choose the kind: a house, an office or a pub. Buildings never run out.
steps.fb-office-kind: First, the kind. Choose an office from the strip below: the teal disc with the briefcase. Offices are where people go when the clock shows the office.
steps.fb-office: Now tap this location to build your office there. It belongs to the crossing at the end of Modem Road, next to the roundabout where a passenger is standing.
steps.fb-house-kind: Your second building is a house: choose the cream disc with the house on it. When the clock comes round to the house, people will want to go home.
steps.fb-house: Tap this location, on the far side of the park.
steps.fb-confirm: Those are your two buildings. Tap Confirm to hand over to Mila.
steps.fl-intro: Now everyone lays the first street of their bus line: tap a street, and a line marker in your colour goes on it. The first one may go on any street at all.
steps.fl-first: Tap Modem Road, between your office's crossing and the roundabout. When the clock reaches the office, that passenger will want to get to work.
steps.fl-reverse: The second street is laid in reverse order: Bram first, then Mila, then you. It must grow from one end of your line, onto an empty street if that end has one.
steps.fl-second: Your turn. Tap Erie Road, from your office's crossing to the train station. New passengers arrive at the stations, and now your line reaches one.
steps.finish: That is the whole game. It is round 3, and you hold the start-bus, so you choose first. The clock will turn to the house next: think about who wants to go home, and where. Good luck!
steps.r1-round: Now for the first round. It has two halves. First we all choose actions. Then the actions happen in reading order: top to bottom, and left to right along each row.
steps.r1-actions: These are the actions, top to bottom. “Line Expansion” lays more of your bus line. “Buses” buys you another bus. “Passengers” brings new passengers to the train stations. “Buildings” puts up new buildings. The “Clock” moves time on, or stops it. “Vrrooomm!” runs your buses, which is how you score. And “Starting Player” lets you choose first next round.
steps.r1-choose: To choose an action you put one of your markers on it, and you must choose at least two each round. Most actions have a row of lettered spaces, and the space you get decides how much the action does. “Buses”, the “Clock” and the “Starting Player” have only one space each.
steps.r1-vroom: Take “Vrrooomm!”: tap its space A. It runs your buses, and it is the only way to score. When the “Clock” action happens, the clock will move to the office. Then the passenger on your roundabout will want to go to work, and your line now reaches an office.
steps.r1-buses: Now take “Buses”: tap its space. You get another bus, and it goes into your column of the depot, just below. Each bus carries one passenger when you run “Vrrooomm!”, so two buses can carry two. “Buses” also matters to everyone. Whoever has the most buses sets how much “Passengers” and “Buildings” do: on space A, one for each of their buses, so right now one. On space B, one less, and so on. “Buses” happens before “Passengers” and “Buildings”, so your new bus makes it two on space A this round.
steps.others-r1-bram2: And Bram takes the “Starting Player”: whoever takes it chooses first next round.
steps.r1-pass: You have chosen two actions, so you may stop. Tap Pass. Your other markers wait for later rounds.
steps.others-r1-resolve: The others finish choosing, and the actions happen: top to bottom, left to right along each row.
steps.r1-carry: Your bus runs. Only one passenger is waiting on your line, and there is only one free office, so there is nothing to choose: the bus drives them from your roundabout to your office, a street at a time. That is your first point.
steps.fl-confirm2: Tap Confirm: the lines are laid, and the first round begins.
steps.others-r1-done: Mila and Bram pass too. Now the actions happen: top to bottom, left to right along each row.
steps.others-r1-line: “Line Expansion” comes first. Bram is on space A, so he adds one street, because nobody has more than one bus yet.
steps.others-r1-bus: Then “Buses”: your second bus goes into the depot. Now you have two, more than anyone, so “Passengers” and “Buildings” do two on space A.
steps.others-r1-passengers: “Passengers”: Mila, on space A, brings two new passengers, and she sets them down at the train stations.
steps.others-r1-buildings: “Buildings”: Mila, on space A, puts up two buildings, on zone 1 locations.
steps.others-r1-clock: Nobody chose the “Clock”, so it moves on, to the office. Now everyone wants to be at work.
steps.others-r1-reseat: Passengers at a crossing with a free office step into it. Anyone left standing wants to go somewhere else, like the passenger on your roundabout, where there is no office.
steps.r1-end: That is the end of the round. Every marker that was used goes back in the box: you have eighteen left. Then a new round begins.
steps.r2-plan: Look ahead. This round the clock will move on to the pub. Then the passenger sitting in your office will want a drink, and you have no pub on your line. So this round you will put up pubs on your roundabout, bring in new passengers, and run your buses.
steps.others-r2-bram1: Bram holds the start-bus, so he chooses first: the “Clock”.
steps.r2-buildings: Take “Buildings”, space A. This row runs F to A, so space A, on the right, happens last, but it builds the most: two.
steps.r2-passengers: Now take “Passengers”, space A: two new passengers, and you choose the station. This row runs A to F, so space A, on the left, goes first.
steps.others-r2-mila2: And Mila takes “Line Expansion” too. Bram has space A, so she gets B.
steps.r2-vroom: Finally, take “Vrrooomm!”, so your buses run after the clock has moved on.
steps.r2-pass: Three actions is enough. Tap Pass.
steps.others-r2-done: Everyone has passed. Now the actions happen, top to bottom.
steps.others-r2-line-mila: “Line Expansion” runs F to A, left to right, so Mila, on space B, goes before Bram, on A. B adds one street, one less than A.
steps.others-r2-line-bram: Then Bram, on space A, adds two streets. A line can only grow from its ends, and must go onto an empty street if that end has one.
steps.r2-pax1: “Passengers”: you are on space A, so you bring two. Tap the station at the end of your line, and a new passenger arrives there.
steps.r2-pax2: And the second one, at the same station.
steps.r2-pub1-kind: “Buildings”: you are on space A, so you build two. Choose a pub, the red disc with the glass and the mug.
steps.r2-pub1: Tap a location on your roundabout.
steps.others-r2-clock: The “Clock” is Bram's. He could stop time by taking one of these time stones, which costs him a point at the end, and the clock would stay at the office. Instead he lets it run, so the clock moves on to the pub. When the last stone is taken, the game ends immediately.
steps.others-r2-reseat: Now everyone wants a drink. Your passenger leaves your office and stands at its crossing, waiting for a bus, like the two at your station.
steps.r2-carry1: “Vrrooomm!” Each bus carries one waiting passenger, and you must carry as many as you can. Three passengers are waiting on your line and you have two buses, so you carry two, and you choose which. Tap one of them.
steps.r2-carry1-to: Now tap either pub on your roundabout, and the bus takes them there. Each pub holds just one passenger, and every delivery scores a point. To change your mind, tap a different passenger first.
steps.r2-carry2: Your second bus carries one more. Tap another waiting passenger.
steps.r2-carry2-to: Tap the pub that is still free. That makes three points, and the passenger left over keeps waiting.
steps.others-r2-start: Nobody chose “Starting Player”, so the start-bus passes to the player on the left, which is you.
steps.others-r2-bram-build: Bram is on space B, left of your A, so he builds first: one building, one less than A.
steps.close-lines: A few rules have not come up yet. Your line always grows from one of its two ends, onto an empty street if that end has one. If an end has no empty street, you may run alongside another line there instead. And where your end meets another player's end, you may run alongside their line for one street, even if empty streets are left. But you can never run alongside your own line.
steps.close-loops: A line may loop back and cross itself, but it can never use a street twice. When one of its ends lands on a crossing the line already passes, a spent action marker stands beside that crossing, to show everyone where the end is.
steps.close-zones: Zone 1 has one free location left. Once it is built, zone 2 opens, then zone 3 and zone 4. When every location is built, the game ends after that round.
steps.close-end: The game can end in three ways. It ends immediately when the last time stone is taken from the clock. It ends after the round in which every building location is built. And it ends after any round in which only one player, or nobody, still has action markers.
steps.close-score: At the end, you lose one point for each time stone you took. The player with the most points wins. If there is a tie, the tied player with more time stones wins, and if that is still tied, whoever reached that score first.
steps.close-aid: The player aid, up here, shows the clock, the scores so far, and what each action space would do right now. Open it whenever you like.
steps.others-r1-start: The last action is “Starting Player”. Bram chose it, so he takes the start-bus and will choose first next round.
